fields.description: Issue includes local gossip and commentary columns ("They Tell Me" and "I'd Like to Know"), extensive racing coverage and tips (horse racing at Hialeah and New Orleans Fair Grounds; dog racing column "Tracking the Dogs" by "The Rabbitt"), and discussion of racing politics and figures (including references to Col. Abe Hallow and J. E. Widener). Also contains a report on N.R.A.-related wage restitution and compliance involving Miami dress manufacturers, along with numerous advertisements for Miami-area bars, restaurants, nightclubs, services, and political ads.
